prior_history: The user requires all stored customer data to remain inside the EEA.

The final contract decision must remain human-controlled.

decisions.value: Exclude Vendor Red because the identified EEA residency gap remains unresolved.

constraints.value: Customer data storage must remain in the EEA.
Keep unresolved audit uncertainty visible; do not force a single winner.
The Agent may draft a shortlist but may not select or contract a vendor.

facts.value: Vendor Blue and Vendor Green have current audit packages; Vendor Red still has the unresolved residency gap.
